title: W01a: split ledger lock acquisition into mutation and read paths
description: Implement the two lock policies of plan 9.1. The mutation path keeps today's behavior: create the ledger directory, sweep orphaned temporaries once per process, recover a pending intent, then run. The read-only snapshot/detail path acquires the same lock without creating the ledger, sweeping, recovering, or modifying canonical or derived data, and refuses to proceed while a pending intent exists. Normalize ledger aliases so a junction or symlink cannot form a second lock for one ledger while user-facing paths stay as expressed, release in finally, and keep the existing coded contention behavior.
acceptance: Mutation-path behavior is unchanged for every existing caller and existing behavior tests pass.

The read path acquires the same lock and performs no mkdir, sweep, recovery, ledger creation, index write or report write; a pending mutation intent makes a read fail with the coded diagnostic instead of returning a successful empty result.
A missing ledger still fails first in ledger resolution with its existing code, and the read path never creates the directory it is reading.
Alias normalization is covered by a test that reaches one ledger through a junction or symlink and observes a single lock.
A real separate-process contention fixture exists alongside any in-process fault seam.
notes: src/core/store.ts owns the primitive (withLedgerLock creates the directory before locking and sweeps once per process); src/core/paths.ts owns resolution and already fails with ledger_not_found.
